title: Why Struggle with Continuous Latents? Interpretable Discrete Latent Reasoning via Rendered Compression
abstract: arXiv:2606.29712v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models achieve high reasoning performance via explicit chain-of-thought and reinforcement learning, but require long output sequences and extended inference time. Latent reasoning reduces this cost by shifting computation into a latent space; however, continuous latent methods are hard to train, suffering from unstable and uninterpretable reasoning trajectories. We argue these issues stem from a misalignment between continuous-space reasoning and discrete symbolic supervision, as continuous states lack explicit anchors for step-by-step alignment. To resolve this, we propose \textbf{Discrete Latent Reasoning~(DLR)}, the first method that converts continuous latent states into explicit discrete tokens. Inspired by render-based compression, we render textual chains of thought into images, extract visual features, and construct a discrete latent vocabulary via clustering-based fine-tuning. translated_title: 为什么要与连续潜变量苦苦纠缠？基于渲染压缩的可解释离散潜变量推理
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通过显式的思维链和强化学习实现了较高的推理性能，但需要较长的输出序列和较长的推理时间。潜空间推理通过将计算转移到潜空间中来降低这一成本；然而，连续潜变量方法难以训练，存在推理轨迹不稳定和不可解释的问题。我们认为这些问题源于连续空间推理与离散符号监督之间的失配，因为连续状态缺乏用于逐步对齐的显式锚点。为解决这一问题，我们提出了离散潜变量推理（Discrete Latent Reasoning，DLR），这是首个将连续潜变量状态转换为显式离散标记的方法。受基于渲染的压缩技术启发，我们将文本思维链渲染为图像，提取视觉特征，并通过基于聚类的微调构建离散潜变量词表。通过扩展词表并超越……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出首个离散潜变量推理方法（DLR），通过将文本思维链渲染为图像并基于聚类微调构建离散潜变量词表，把连续潜变量状态转换为显式离散标记，从而实现更稳定、可解释且高效的潜空间推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Discrete Latent Reasoning (DLR), the first method that converts continuous latent states into explicit discrete tokens by rendering textual chains-of-thought into images and constructing a discrete latent vocabulary via clustering-based fine-tuning, enabling more stable, interpretable, and efficient latent reasoning.
